ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the synchronous clock to instantiated submodules; connected into each instance's clk_i port so those instances sequence their registers on this edge.
ports.evidence: Connected in many port maps (e.g. frontend, control, alu, lsu, regfile) via clk_i => clk_i.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the active-low reset to instantiated submodules; connected into each instance's rstn_i so instances recover to reset state when asserted.
ports.evidence: Connected in many port maps (e.g. frontend, control, alu, lsu, regfile) via rstn_i => rstn_i.

ports.name: msi_i
ports.functionality: Supplies one interrupt input bit that is ANDed with mei_i and mti_i to form irq_machine; contributes to the irq_machine vector read by control.
ports.evidence: Combined in combinational assignment irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i.

ports.name: mei_i
ports.functionality: Supplies one interrupt input bit that is ANDed with msi_i and mti_i to form irq_machine; contributes to the irq_machine vector read by control.
ports.evidence: Combined in combinational assignment irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i.

ports.name: mti_i
ports.functionality: Supplies one interrupt input bit that is ANDed with mei_i and msi_i to form irq_machine; contributes to the irq_machine vector read by control.
ports.evidence: Combined in combinational assignment irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i.

ports.name: firq_i
ports.functionality: Provides the fast/priority interrupt vector into the control unit; connected directly into the control instance's irq_fast_i port.
ports.evidence: Port mapped in control: irq_fast_i => firq_i.

ports.name: dbi_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the debug interrupt signal into the control unit; connected directly into the control instance's irq_dbg_i input.
ports.evidence: Port mapped in control: irq_dbg_i => dbi_i.

ports.name: icc_tx_o
ports.functionality: Exports the ICC transmit record from the internal ICC instance when enabled, otherwise driven to a terminate constant when ICC_EN is false.
ports.evidence: Mapped in icc_enabled port map; assigned in icc_disabled: icc_tx_o <= icc_terminate_c.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.rdy
ports.functionality: Field of the exported ICC transmit record; mirrors the corresponding field produced by the ICC instance or the terminate value when ICC disabled.
ports.evidence: Whole-record port map to ICC and icc_tx_o <= icc_terminate_c when ICC disabled.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.ack
ports.functionality: Field of the exported ICC transmit record; mirrors the corresponding field produced by the ICC instance or the terminate value when ICC disabled.
ports.evidence: Whole-record port map to ICC and icc_tx_o <= icc_terminate_c when ICC disabled.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.dat
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field of the exported ICC transmit record; driven from the ICC instance or set to the termination constant when ICC disabled.
ports.evidence: Whole-record port map to ICC and icc_tx_o <= icc_terminate_c when ICC disabled.

ports.name: icc_rx_i
ports.functionality: Receives the ICC receive record from outside and supplies it to the internal ICC instance when ICC is enabled via port mapping.
ports.evidence: Mapped in icc_enabled port map: icc_rx_i => icc_rx_i.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.rdy
ports.functionality: Field of the ICC receive record input; forwarded to the ICC instance via the whole-record port map.
ports.evidence: Whole-record port mapping of icc_rx_i into ICC instance.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.ack
ports.functionality: Field of the ICC receive record input; forwarded to the ICC instance via the whole-record port map.
ports.evidence: Whole-record port mapping of icc_rx_i into ICC instance.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.dat
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field of the ICC receive input; forwarded to the internal ICC instance via the whole-record port map.
ports.evidence: Whole-record port mapping of icc_rx_i into ICC instance.

ports.name: ibus_req_o
ports.functionality: Exports the instruction bus request record which is produced by the frontend instance; the whole record is carried from the frontend to the entity boundary.
ports.evidence: Mapped in frontend port map: ibus_req_o => ibus_req_o.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Address field of the instruction bus request; produced by the frontend and exported via the aggregate ibus_req_o.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Data field of the instruction bus request; produced by the frontend and exported at the entity boundary.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: Byte-enable field of the instruction bus request; produced by frontend and exported.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Strobe flag of the instruction bus request; carried from the frontend instance to the entity output.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Read/write direction field from the frontend's instruction bus request; exported at the entity boundary.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Source field of the instruction bus request record from frontend; exported unchanged.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Privilege indicator field of the frontend's ibus request record; passed to the external bus.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Debug indicator field of the frontend ibus request; exported unchanged.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.amo

ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: AMO opcode field of the instruction bus request produced by the frontend and exported.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Lock flag from frontend ibus request; carried to external bus.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Fence indicator field from frontend's request record; exported unchanged.
ports.evidence: Frontend port mapping provides the whole ibus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Receives instruction bus responses from outside and forwards the whole response record into the frontend instance via port map.
ports.evidence: Frontend port map: ibus_rsp_i => ibus_rsp_i.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: ACK bit of the external instruction bus response; forwarded into the frontend instance.
ports.evidence: Frontend port map passes ibus_rsp_i into the frontend instance.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Error flag of the instruction bus response; forwarded into the frontend instance for handling.
ports.evidence: Frontend port map passes ibus_rsp_i into the frontend instance.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field of instruction bus responses; forwarded into frontend instance for instruction supply.
ports.evidence: Frontend port map passes ibus_rsp_i into the frontend instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o

ports.name: dbus_req_o.data

ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.ben

ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Strobe flag for data-bus request from LSU; exported to the bus interface.
ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Read/write indicator of the LSU's data-bus request; exported unchanged.
ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Source metadata field from the LSU's dbus request record; exported to the external bus.
ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Privilege flag of the LSU dbus request; exported.
ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Debug indicator field of the LSU data-bus request; exported unchanged.
ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Atomic-memory-op flag produced by the LSU and exported on the data bus request record.
ports.evidence: LSU port mapping provides the whole dbus_req_o record to the entity.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: AMO opcode field of the LSU dbus request; exported unchanged.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.lock

ports.name: dbus_req_o.fence

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Receives data-bus responses from outside and forwards the whole response record into the LSU instance via port map.
ports.evidence: LSU port map: dbus_rsp_i => dbus_rsp_i.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: ACK bit of the external data-bus response; forwarded into the LSU instance.
ports.evidence: LSU port map passes dbus_rsp_i into the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Error flag of the data-bus response; forwarded into the LSU instance.
ports.evidence: LSU port map passes dbus_rsp_i into the LSU instance.

signals.name: xcsr_cnt
signals.functionality: Collects CSR bits produced by the counters unit when enabled, otherwise set to zero; participates in forming xcsr_res.
signals.evidence: Assigned from counters rdata_o via port map or set to zeros in cnts_disabled; used in xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or ...

signals.name: xcsr_pmp
signals.functionality: Carries CSR bits produced by the PMP instance when PMP enabled, otherwise zero; is ORed into xcsr_res.
signals.evidence: Assigned from PMP csr_o in pmp_enabled or set to (others=>'0') in pmp_disabled; used in xcsr_res <= ...

signals.name: xcsr_alu
signals.functionality: Receives CSR output from the ALU instance and is ORed into xcsr_res for CSR readback.
signals.evidence: ALU port map: csr_o => xcsr_alu; xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc.

signals.name: xcsr_res
signals.functionality: Combines xcsr_cnt, xcsr_alu, xcsr_pmp and xcsr_icc with bitwise OR and provides the result to the control unit as CSR readback.
signals.evidence: Assigned by xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc; mapped into control as xcsr_rdata_i => xcsr_res.

signals.name: xcsr_icc
signals.functionality: Receives CSR readback from the ICC instance when enabled, otherwise zero; is ORed into xcsr_res.
signals.evidence: Mapped in icc_enabled: csr_rdata_o => xcsr_icc; set to zeros in icc_disabled; used in xcsr_res combine.

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds the control/control-state record driven by the control instance and forwards that record to frontend, regfile, ALU, LSU, PMP and ICC instances.
signals.evidence: Control instance port map: ctrl_o => ctrl; many instances receive ctrl via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.if_fence
signals.functionality: Field of the control record produced by the control unit; available to submodules via the ctrl record for instruction-fence behavior.
signals.evidence: Field exists in ctrl record which is driven by control instance (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.if_reset
signals.functionality: Field of the control record driven by the control instance; used by submodules when they read the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record supplied by control instance (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.if_ack
signals.functionality: Ack field carried in the ctrl record from the control instance to other units; present when ctrl is forwarded to submodules.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record supplied by control instance (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.pc_cur
signals.functionality: Field of the control record holding current PC value; produced by the control instance and available to other blocks via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: pc fields are members of ctrl record supplied by control via ctrl_o => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_nxt
signals.functionality: Control-record field for the next PC value; produced by the control instance and forwarded via ctrl.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record driven by control instance.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_ret
signals.functionality: Return-PC field produced by the control instance; supplied as one alternative writeback source into the register file (rf_wdata).
signals.evidence: rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret; ctrl is driven by control (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.rf_wb_en
signals.functionality: RF write-enable field provided by the control instance inside the ctrl record; consumed by submodules that read ctrl.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl record driven by control (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rs1
signals.functionality: Source register index field inside ctrl produced by the control instance; forwarded to register file and other units via ctrl.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record supplied by control (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rs2
signals.functionality: Source register index field inside ctrl produced by the control instance; provided via ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record supplied by control (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rd
signals.functionality: Destination register index field inside ctrl from the control instance; used by regfile when ctrl is supplied.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record supplied by control (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.rf_zero_we
signals.functionality: Flag inside ctrl that can disable writes to x0; provided by the control instance and carried to regfile via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record supplied by control (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.alu_op
signals.functionality: ALU operation selection bits produced by control and delivered to the ALU via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: ALU receives ctrl record (ctrl_i => ctrl) which contains alu_op set by control.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_sub
signals.functionality: Subtract selection bit inside the control record produced by control and consumed by the ALU via ctrl.
signals.evidence: ALU receives ctrl_i => ctrl; field is part of ctrl driven by control.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_opa_mux
signals.functionality: Operand A multiplexer select inside the ctrl record; produced by control and read by the ALU instance.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record driven by control and passed to ALU via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_opb_mux
signals.functionality: Operand B multiplexer select inside ctrl; provided by control and consumed by ALU via ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record driven by control and passed to ALU via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_unsigned
signals.functionality: Unsigned arithmetic indicator inside ctrl produced by control and read by ALU via ctrl record.
signals.evidence: ALU receives ctrl_i => ctrl which includes alu_unsigned set by control.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_imm
signals.functionality: Immediate value field inside ctrl provided by the control unit and available to the ALU as an operand via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record driven by control and passed into ALU via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_alu
signals.functionality: Flag in the ctrl record that indicates coprocessor operation to the ALU/CFU/FPU; provided by the control instance and consumed by ALU via ctrl.
signals.evidence: ALU is instantiated with ctrl_i => ctrl which contains alu_cp_alu from control.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_cfu
signals.functionality: CFU coprocessor selection bit inside ctrl produced by control and read by ALU via ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record provided by control (ctrl_o => ctrl) and passed to ALU.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_fpu
signals.functionality: FPU coprocessor selection bit inside ctrl produced by control and consumed by ALU via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record provided by control and used by ALU (ctrl_i => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_req
signals.functionality: LSU request control bit inside ctrl produced by the control instance and read by the LSU via ctrl record.
signals.evidence: LSU gets ctrl via ctrl_i => ctrl; this field is part of the ctrl record.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_rw
signals.functionality: Read/write bit for LSU operations inside ctrl produced by control and used by LSU when ctrl is passed in.
signals.evidence: LSU receives ctrl record (ctrl_i => ctrl) which contains lsu_rw set by control.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_amo
signals.functionality: Atomic-memory-op indicator in ctrl produced by the control instance and read by LSU via ctrl.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record driven by control and passed to LSU.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_mo_we
signals.functionality: Memory-ordered write-enable flag inside ctrl produced by control and read by LSU when the ctrl record is supplied.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record driven by control and passed to LSU (ctrl_i => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_fence
signals.functionality: Fence indicator in the ctrl record, produced by control and read by LSU and other units as needed.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record driven by control and forwarded to LSU via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_priv
signals.functionality: Privilege mode field for LSU operations inside ctrl produced by the control instance and read by LSU via ctrl record.
signals.evidence: Part of the ctrl record driven by control and passed to LSU.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_we

signals.name: ctrl.csr_re

signals.name: ctrl.csr_addr

signals.name: ctrl.cnt_halt

signals.name: ctrl.cnt_event

signals.name: ctrl.ir_funct3
signals.functionality: Instruction funct3 field carried in ctrl and produced by control; used by submodules that read ctrl.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl record provided by control (ctrl_o => ctrl).

signals.name: ctrl.ir_funct12

signals.name: ctrl.ir_opcode

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_priv
signals.functionality: Privilege level field inside ctrl set by the control instance and read by other modules via the ctrl record.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_sleep
signals.functionality: Sleep indicator inside ctrl produced by the control instance; forwarded via the ctrl record to submodules.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_trap

signals.functionality: Fault output from PMP when PMP enabled, otherwise forced low; forwarded to the control instance as pmp_fault_i.
role: derived from PMP instance or forced zero
signals.evidence: PMP port map: fault_o => pmp_fault; pmp_disabled sets pmp_fault <= '0'; control receives pmp_fault_i => pmp_fault.

signals.name: irq_machine
signals.functionality: Composed combinationally from mti_i, mei_i and msi_i and then provided to the control instance as the machine-interrupt vector.
signals.evidence: Assigned irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i; control port map: irq_machine_i => irq_machine.
